reason: Blender 5.x separates media type from image file format; direct FFMPEG assignment through image_settings.file_format is invalid. Use Blender's recommended frame-sequence workflow and encode the verified frames with ffmpeg.
authority_decision: Keep the visible acceptance contract unchanged: 180 frames, 30 fps, 6 seconds, 1080x1080, +90 degree U turn, animated camera, frozen lower layers. Amend only the render/encoding mechanism.

after.pipeline: Blender PNG frame sequence -> ffmpeg H.264 MP4
